reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and consistent with that claim no redline or comment was proposed — the rendered paragraphs are identical to the originals.

The cited paragraphs support the finding: the only 'shall not' covenants binding Licensee are license-scope/field-of-use limits on the Licensor's own Licensed Technology (p0007, p0030, p0035) and a non-solicitation of Licensor employees (p0125), none of which restrain the businesses we may operate or products we may buy or build. The rule expressly treats scope limits on the vendor's IP as outside its target and restrictions binding the Vendor as fine.

The rationale correctly notes, without double-flagging, that the Change of Control consent standard (p0134) and the right of first refusal are assignment/exit constraints properly handled under the change-of-control and assignment rules, consistent with the no-double-flagging instruction.
Deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains, corroborating the compliant classification.
